api.notes: Number or numeric string = px; any other string is a CSS length. Written to a private custom property on the inner part (A§7.2).
none | 0..4 | rounded; numeric attribute strings become numbers.

api.reason: A-xstyle family: data-* attributes are set on the host directly; nothing to map.
A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(base) or the size attributes.

differences.text: The aria-hidden default is ElementInternals state on the host, so a host aria-hidden attribute overrides it exactly as upstream's prop spread lets aria-hidden={false} win.

Radius steps keep upstream's token mapping (1 = radius-inner, 2 = radius-element, 3 and 4 = radius-container), which Tecton resolves to 2, 4 and 8px; upstream's doc comments (4/8/12/16px) describe the Astryx values.

core.skeleton.notes: Guides: [mwg:css] animation timing, reduced-motion pattern (`--_animation-reduced`) and forced colours; [mwg:accessible-web-components] default ARIA through ElementInternals; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts and private custom properties.
